We provide a panel of three graduate students with 50 random entries from each setting, asking them to evaluate whether each entry meets the following criteria and to give a score from 1 to 10: 1) Faithful: whether the response faithfully expresses the confidence; 2) Concise: whether the response conveys necessary information clearly and without excess; 3) Granular: whether the response contains confidence estimates for distinct knowledge.
